records.jp: 記憶の欠片だ……
records.en_original: A memory shard...
records.en_auxiliary: A memory shard...
records.en: It's a memory shard...

records.jp: あなたが最近入ってきた宮内さん？
records.en_original: You're the new rookie, right? Miyauchi?
records.en_auxiliary: You're the new rookie, right? Miyauchi?
records.en: You're Miyauchi-san, the one who joined recently?

records.jp: そうですけど
records.en_original: Yes, that's right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, that's right.
records.en: Yes, I am.

records.jp: 噂は聞いてるよ！<CR>アルバイトから、この研究メンバーに抜擢されたって
records.en_original: I've heard a lot about you! Is it true you started as just an assistant?
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard a lot about you! Is it true you started as just an assistant?
records.en: I've heard about you!<CR>That you were picked for this research team after starting out as a part-timer.

records.jp: なんでも、灰の研究にすごい情熱を持ってるとか！<CR>これから一緒に頑張ろうね！
records.en_original: You must really be good if you worked your way up to researcher! I'm looking forward to working with you!
records.en_auxiliary: You must really be good if you worked your way up to researcher! I'm looking forward to working with you!
records.en: I also heard you're incredibly passionate about researching the Ash!<CR>Let's do our best together from here on out!

records.jp: はい。一日でも早く灰の問題を解決したいです。<CR>よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Yes. Anything to solve the Ash crisis as soon as possible.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Anything to solve the Ash crisis as soon as possible.
records.en: Yes. I want to solve the Ash problem as soon as possible.<CR>Please, help me do that.

records.jp: 私は先に上がろうと思うけど……。<CR>そっちはまだ残るの？
records.en_original: I'm thinking of calling it a day. Are you going to keep working?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm thinking of calling it a day. Are you going to keep working?
records.en: I'm thinking of heading home first...<CR>Are you still staying?

records.jp: どうしても今日中にやりたいなら手伝うよ。<CR>一人じゃ大変でしょ？
records.en_original: If you really want to get it done today, I can give you a hand. It'd go faster with two, right?
records.en_auxiliary: If you really want to get it done today, I can give you a hand. It'd go faster with two, right?
records.en: If you absolutely want to finish it today, I'll help.<CR>It'd be tough by yourself, right?

records.jp: いい。<CR>あなたはさっさと帰ったら
records.en_original: I'm fine. Go home.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm fine. Go home.
records.en: I'm fine.<CR>You should just go home already.

records.jp: 灰の研究をしたがっているリフレクターがいる。<CR>そう聞いて君を招いてみたが、正解だった
records.en_original: I brought you on because I heard there was a Reflector who wanted to study the Ash—and I don't regret it.
records.en_auxiliary: I brought you on because I heard there was a Reflector who wanted to study the Ash—and I don't regret it.
records.en: I heard there was a Reflector who wanted to study the Ash.<CR>So I invited you here, and that proved to be the right call.

records.jp: いろいろ、意欲的に働いてくれて助かっている
records.en_original: We've made great progress thanks to your determination.
records.en_auxiliary: We've made great progress thanks to your determination.
records.en: You've been a great help, working so enthusiastically in all sorts of ways.

records.jp: ただ、何をそんなに焦っている？<CR>そんなに働き詰めでは君の生活が……
records.en_original: But... Why the hurry? Working like this can't be good for you...
records.en_auxiliary: But... Why the hurry? Working like this can't be good for you...
records.en: But why are you in such a hurry?<CR>If you keep working yourself this hard, your life...

records.jp: 逆になんで焦らないんですか！？<CR>今にも息絶えようとしている人がいるのに！
records.en_original: Why shouldn't I be in a hurry?! People are dying!
records.en_auxiliary: Why shouldn't I be in a hurry?! People are dying!
records.en: Then why aren't you in a hurry?!<CR>There are people who could die at any moment!

records.jp: は……はは、なにこれ
records.en_original: Haha... What was that...?
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... What was that...?
records.en: H... haha, what is this?

records.jp: こんなだったんだ、私……
records.en_original: That was who I was, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: That was who I was, huh...
records.en: So that was what I was like...

records.jp: なんていうか、その……。<CR>追い詰められてるみたい。すごく
records.en_original: You were like an animal driven into a corner, lashing out to defend yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: You were like an animal driven into a corner, lashing out to defend yourself.
records.en: How do I put it...?<CR>Like you were really cornered.

records.jp: あの頃は、みんなバカだと思ってたの
records.en_original: I thought everyone around me was a fool back then.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought everyone around me was a fool back then.
records.en: Back then, I thought everyone was an idiot.

records.jp: 必死に研究してるのは私だけ。<CR>私以上に灰に向き合っている人なんていないって
records.en_original: I joined AASA, but no one was as dedicated to their research as I was. No one else more focused.
records.en_auxiliary: I joined AASA, but no one was as dedicated to their research as I was. No one else more focused.
records.en: That I was the only one desperately doing research.<CR>That there wasn't anyone facing the Ash more seriously than I was.

records.jp: だって、私には大切な人の命がかかってる！<CR>その気持ちがあんたらなんかに分かってたまるか！
records.en_original: The life of someone important to me was at stake! None of them could understand!
records.en_auxiliary: The life of someone important to me was at stake! None of them could understand!
records.en: Because the life of someone important to me was on the line!<CR>As if people like you could ever understand how I felt!

records.jp: けど、バカだったのは私だ
records.en_original: But I was the real fool.
records.en_auxiliary: But I was the real fool.
records.en: But I was the idiot.

records.jp: みんなそれぞれ事情や想いがあったはずなのにね
records.en_original: I'm sure that each person there had their own circumstances to deal with. Their own feelings.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure that each person there had their own circumstances to deal with. Their own feelings.
records.en: Even though each of them must have had their own circumstances and feelings.

records.jp: だってそうじゃなきゃ、自分が病気になるリスクを<CR>冒してまで灰の研究なんかしない
records.en_original: Why would they risk getting sick themselves doing research otherwise?
records.en_auxiliary: Why would they risk getting sick themselves doing research otherwise?
records.en: Because otherwise, they wouldn't do research on the Ash<CR>while risking getting sick themselves.

records.jp: みんな命を懸けてたんだ
records.en_original: Everyone there put their life on the line.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone there put their life on the line.
records.en: Everyone was risking their lives.

records.jp: みんな私に手を差し伸べてくれてたんだ
records.en_original: Everyone offered to help me.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone offered to help me.
records.en: Everyone was reaching out a hand to me.

records.jp: なのに、私は自分しか信じられなくって……！
records.en_original: But I couldn't let myself trust anyone...
records.en_auxiliary: But I couldn't let myself trust anyone...
records.en: And yet... I could only trust myself...!

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: It's okay.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay.
records.en: It's okay.

records.jp: 今からでも遅くない。<CR>みんなで乗り越えていこうよ
records.en_original: It's not too late. We can get through this together.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not too late. We can get through this together.
records.en: It's not too late.<CR>Let's get through this together.

records.jp: 星崎さん……
records.en_original: Hoshizaki...
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki...
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: 信じられるでしょ？<CR>この世界で出会った、みんなのことは
records.en_original: All the people you've met here... You can trust us, can't you?
records.en_auxiliary: All the people you've met here... You can trust us, can't you?
records.en: You can trust them, can't you?<CR>All the people you met in this world.

records.jp: 違う、信じられるのは自分だけ。<CR>そうでしょう？
records.en_original: No. The only one you can trust is yourself. Isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: No. The only one you can trust is yourself. Isn't that right?
records.en: No, the only one you can trust is yourself.<CR>Isn't that right?

records.jp: 伶那！
records.en_original: Rena!
records.en_auxiliary: Rena!
records.en: Rena!

records.jp: ……いいえ
records.en_original: No.
records.en_auxiliary: No.

records.jp: この世界の人たちはね。<CR>あなたが思っているよりも、強くて優しいの
records.en_original: The people here are so much stronger, so much kinder than you know.
records.en_auxiliary: The people here are so much stronger, so much kinder than you know.
records.en: The people of this world, you know.<CR>They're stronger and kinder than you think.

records.jp: 私は信じる。<CR>この世界のみんなを
records.en_original: I believe in them.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in them.
records.en: I believe.<CR>In everyone in this world.

records.jp: ありがとう、星崎さん。<CR>あなたのおかげで気づくことができた
records.en_original: Thank you, Hoshizaki. This wouldn't have been possible without your help.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Hoshizaki. This wouldn't have been possible without your help.
records.en: Thank you, Hoshizaki-san.<CR>Thanks to you, I was able to realize that.

records.jp: もっとみんなをちゃんと信じてみることにする
records.en_original: From now on, I'll try my best to put my trust in others.
records.en_auxiliary: From now on, I'll try my best to put my trust in others.
records.en: I'll try properly trusting everyone more.

records.jp: まずは私からだね
records.en_original: Starting with me, yeah?
records.en_auxiliary: Starting with me, yeah?
records.en: Starting with me, right?

records.jp: バカ。あなたのことは、とっくに信じてる。<CR>だから――
records.en_original: Don't be silly. I've trusted you for a long time now. So—
records.en_auxiliary: Don't be silly. I've trusted you for a long time now. So—
records.en: Idiot. I've trusted you for a long time.<CR>So—

records.jp: これからもそばで私を支えてくれる？<CR>私の一番の、仲間として
records.en_original: I'll be counting on your support. That's what friends do, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be counting on your support. That's what friends do, isn't it?
records.en: Will you keep supporting me from here on too?<CR>As my closest comrade.

records.jp: もちろん
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course!
records.en: Of course.

records.jp: （伶那さんが伶那さんでいられるのは、きっと<CR>誰かのために一生懸命になれるから）
records.en_original: (I think I know how she does it now. She puts everything she has into caring for others.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think I know how she does it now. She puts everything she has into caring for others.)
records.en: (Rena-san can stay Rena-san, I'm sure, because she can throw<CR>herself wholeheartedly into something for someone else's sake.)

records.jp: （誰かのために、人生をかけられる人だから）
records.en_original: (She's the type of person who would risk her life for someone else.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's the type of person who would risk her life for someone else.)
records.en: (Because she's the kind of person who can stake her life for someone else.)

records.jp: （だからみんな、伶那さんに手を差し伸べるんだよ）
records.en_original: (That's why everyone wants to help her too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's why everyone wants to help her too.)
records.en: (That's why everyone reaches out a hand to Rena-san.)

records.jp: （伶那さんはカッコいい人だと、私は思ってる）
records.en_original: (Rena sure is cool.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Rena sure is cool.)
records.en: (I think Rena-san is really cool.)
